item.title: Infinite Inventory Add-On 1.0
item.creator: Shapescape
item.description: Stop running back to chests. No more need for backpacks. Infinite Inventory gives every player a tabbed, expandable storage system right in their inventory! Flip through pages, auto-deposit pickups, and swap your hotbar in one tap! Fully customizable, survival-friendly!

faqEntries.heading: How many inventory pages do I get?
faqEntries.content: Up to 1,012 per player. You start with 2 and buy the rest with diamonds. Every page holds its own 27 inventory slots.

faqEntries.heading: How do I unlock more pages?
faqEntries.content: Open your inventory and press the Inventory Navigation button. Tap the Unlock Page button in the slot right after your last page. It shows the price and pays with your diamonds.

faqEntries.heading: Why does it say I have 0 diamonds when I am holding plenty?
faqEntries.content: Only diamonds in your hotbar or on the page you had open can be spent. Diamonds stored on other pages cannot be reached from the menu. Move them to your hotbar and try again.

faqEntries.heading: Do I have to buy pages?
faqEntries.content: No, if you prefer a non-survival type gameplay, you can turn Page Unlocking off in Settings and every page is free. Your unlock progress is saved in case you turn it back on.

faqEntries.heading: Does my hotbar change when I switch pages?
faqEntries.content: No. Your hotbar stays the same on every page, so your tools and weapons are always with you.

faqEntries.heading: Does every player get their own pages?
faqEntries.content: Yes. Pages, hotbar layouts, and settings are saved per player and stay through deaths, server restarts, and dimension changes.

howToEntries.content:
Infinite Inventory gives you extra inventory pages. You start with 2 and can own up to 1,012, and each page holds its own 27 slots. Your hotbar is shared across every page, so your tools stay with you wherever you go.

GETTING STARTED
1. Join the world. You get the Infinite Inventory Add-on book on your first join. Read it for a quick overview.
2. Open your inventory. Three new buttons sit in the grid: Previous, Next, and Inventory Navigation.
3. Press Next to move to page 2, and Previous to come back. Each button label shows the page you are heading to.
4. Press Inventory Navigation to see all your pages at once. Tap any page to jump straight to it.

BUYING A NEW PAGE
1. Put the diamonds you want to spend in your hotbar, or on the page you are standing on.
2. Press Inventory Navigation to open the page overview.
3. Find the Unlock Page button. It sits in the slot right after your last page and shows the price along with the diamonds you have available.
4. Tap it to buy the page.

Pages 1 and 2 are free. Pages 3 to 9 cost 8 diamonds each, and the price goes up by 8 every 15 pages after that, stopping at 64 diamonds from page 100 onwards.

Only diamonds in your hotbar or on the page you had open can be spent. Diamonds stored on any other page do not count, so move them to your hotbar first if the button says you cannot afford it.

TURNING PAGE BUYING OFF
1. Press Inventory Navigation, then Settings.
2. Press Page Unlocking to switch it to Off.

Every page is now free. Pages open up as you fill the one before them, and your unlock progress is kept safe if you ever switch back.

SAVING HOTBAR LAYOUTS
1. Find the Hotbar Controller in slot 9 of your hotbar.
2. Interact with it to switch to the next of your 9 saved hotbars.
3. Attack with it to go back to the previous one.

Set one hotbar up for mining, one for building, and one for combat, then swap between them in a single press. Turn the Hotbar Controller off in Settings to free up slot 9.

MOVING THE BUTTONS
1. Open Settings and press Move Inventory Buttons.
2. Drag Previous, Next, Inventory Navigation, and Settings into any of your 27 slots.
3. Press Save.

On a phone or tablet, set UI Type to Pocket in Settings instead. This moves the buttons to the bottom right of your inventory, where your thumbs can reach them.
